result.title: VISOR: A Vision-Language Selector for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
result.summary: Recent time-series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast a distribution over futures, and multimodal time-series (TS) forecasting further exploits other modalities to improve forecasting accuracy. However, existing works have two limitations: 1) TSFMs reduce the predictive distribution to its median or mean, flattening diverse futures into a calm line, and 2) multimodal TS forecasting models incorporate text into the forecaster through TS-language alignment, which is substantially weaker than vision-language alignment. To address these limitations, we propose the VIsion-language SelectOR (VISOR), a multimodal TS forecasting framework that selects one plausible future instead of averaging across candidates, leveraging the alignment capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) to select the most suitable candidate based on textual information. VISOR consists of two components: 1) a text-free stochastic predictor that samples diverse candidate futures, and 2) a VLM selector that reads the candidates as a single chart image and selects one based on the text. To avoid overly calm forecasting paths, we train the selector with a shape-aware target that evaluates each candidate based on both point-wise error and path shape. Across three benchmarks covering ten datasets, VISOR achieves the best average ranking in both point and volatility errors compared with TSFMs and multimodal TS forecasting models. Code: https://github.com/seunghan96/VISOR.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 VISOR 用于多模态时间序列预测：先用无文本的随机预测器采样多条候选未来，再由 VLM 把候选绘制成一张图表并结合文本选出其中最合适的一条，并以兼顾逐点误差与路径形状的目标训练该选择器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「候选生成＋VLM 以图文联合方式筛选/验证一条假设」的流程，可能与 LVR 中多 latent 假设的视觉证据筛选与选择环节相关；形状感知训练目标可供核查选择器是否真正依赖视觉内容而非先验，但任务属时间序列预测，迁移需自行判断。
